findings.evidence: When several compete for Rep 1, pick the one with the smallest shippable test inside the user's available time.
findings.fix: Add a tie-break that weighs size against the stated goal, for example: 'among lessons whose test fits the budget, prefer the one closest to the user's goal; smallest wins only as a tie-break', so Rep 1 does not land on a trivial but irrelevant lesson.

findings.evidence: Never report a plan file as saved before the write succeeded; a tool-less or chat-only run must say the plan was not saved.
